issue.title: rust-lsp-install copies sase-xprompt-lsp from the checkout-local target dir and exits 0 after cp/chmod/mv fail
issue.description: just install reports a successful sase-xprompt-lsp install while actually copying nothing, because rust-lsp-install hard-codes the checkout-local cargo target directory and its single-line install step never propagates a copy failure. Found twice while landing epic sase-um (phase notes sase-um.3 and sase-um.4).

task_type_fields.impact:
Every agent whose host sets a cargo `target-dir` (this one does, globally) silently
keeps a stale `sase-xprompt-lsp` in its workspace venv while `just install` reports
success. Nothing downstream can notice: the recipe's exit code is 0, so `just install`
is green and no gate re-checks the installed binary's version. Agents then debug
xprompt LSP behavior against a binary that does not match the tree they are editing.
task_type_fields.repro:
`just install` runs `rust-lsp-install` (Justfile:998). Its build step is

    cd "{{ sase_core_dir }}" && cargo build --release -p sase_xprompt_lsp

and its install step (Justfile:1015-1022) then copies from a hard-coded path:

    dest="{{ VENV }}/bin/sase-xprompt-lsp"; \
    src="{{ sase_core_dir }}/target/release/sase-xprompt-lsp"; \
    tmp="$dest.tmp.$$"; \
    trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT; \
    cp "$src" "$tmp"; \
    chmod +x "$tmp"; \
    mv -f "$tmp" "$dest"; \
    printf "[rust-lsp-install] installed %s\n" "$dest"

Two independent defects compound:

1. `src` assumes cargo wrote to the checkout-local `target/`. This host's
   `~/.cargo/config.toml` sets `target-dir = "/mnt/poseidon/cargo-target"`, so the
   binary is actually at `/mnt/poseidon/cargo-target/release/sase-xprompt-lsp` and the
   `cp` reads a path that does not exist. `CARGO_TARGET_DIR`, a workspace
   `.cargo/config.toml`, and `build.target-dir` are all equally unhandled.

2. The whole install step is one `@`-prefixed, `;`-separated shell line with no
   `set -e`. A failing `cp` therefore does not stop `chmod` or `mv`, and the recipe's
   exit status is `printf`'s, which is 0. So the recipe prints cp/chmod/mv errors,
   prints `[rust-lsp-install] installed ...`, and exits 0.

REPRODUCE:

    grep -n 'target-dir' ~/.cargo/config.toml     # target-dir = /mnt/poseidon/cargo-target
    just install                                   # prints cp/chmod/mv errors, exits 0
    .venv/bin/sase-xprompt-lsp --version           # stale version, not the one just built

Observed twice while landing epic sase-um: phase sase-um.4 recorded `just install`
building `sase-xprompt-lsp` under `/mnt/poseidon/cargo-target/release`, trying to copy
from the checkout-local target, printing cp/chmod/mv failures, and still exiting 0.
Phase sase-um.3 independently recorded the same shape with a concrete version skew:
`.venv/bin/sase-xprompt-lsp --version` reported 0.32.6 after `sase_core_rs` 0.32.8 had
been built in the same `just install`.

payload.entry:
Reproduced live on 2026-08-28 in workspace sase_12 at master 52327ed78, during the sase-um land turn that filed this bead (same reporter, so recorded as a note rather than a +1). `just install` exited 0 and printed `[rust-lsp-install] installed .../.venv/bin/sase-xprompt-lsp` immediately after these three lines:

    cp: cannot stat '.../sase/repos/linked/sase-core/target/release/sase-xprompt-lsp': No such file or directory
    chmod: cannot access '.../.venv/bin/sase-xprompt-lsp.tmp.2738280': No such file or directory
    mv: cannot stat '.../.venv/bin/sase-xprompt-lsp.tmp.2738280': No such file or directory

`.venv/bin/sase-xprompt-lsp --version` then reported `sase-xprompt-lsp 0.32.6` while the same `just install` had just built and installed `sase_core_rs` 0.32.12 from the linked checkout.

payload.description: stale/missing sase-xprompt-lsp from rust-lsp-install can make LspSession fail or return stale wait: completions

evidence.note: Independently hit during epic sase-um.9.5, proposed by phase bead sase-um.9.5.4 (note #10) on 2026-08-29 while driving Full CI green on master 25565fca1. Same root cause as this bead: rust-lsp-install copies from the hard-coded checkout-local `{{ sase_core_dir }}/target/release/sase-xprompt-lsp`, but this host's cargo target-dir is /mnt/poseidon/cargo-target, so `just install` reports success while leaving whatever sase-xprompt-lsp already sat in .venv/bin. Impact on that phase: an agent that had just ratcheted sase-core could not trust the LSP binary in its workspace venv after a green install.

Reproduced again on 2026-08-30 in workspace sase_20 at master 18fa499a3 while landing epic sase-vs (proposed by phase bead sase-vs.2, note #1). `just install` printed the same three failures and still reported success:

    cp: cannot stat '.../sase/repos/linked/sase-core/target/release/sase-xprompt-lsp': No such file or directory
    chmod: cannot access '.../.venv/bin/sase-xprompt-lsp.tmp.3394096': No such file or directory
    mv: cannot stat '.../.venv/bin/sase-xprompt-lsp.tmp.3394096': No such file or directory
    [rust-lsp-install] installed .../.venv/bin/sase-xprompt-lsp

`~/.cargo/config.toml` still sets `target-dir = /mnt/poseidon/cargo-target`, and the workspace venv kept an Aug 29 sase-xprompt-lsp binary that `just install` never replaced. Impact for sase-vs.2: the phase could not trust the LSP binary when checking ACE/LSP wait-range parity for the new approval wait spec, so this bug now reaches phases that touch %wait handling.

Independent reproduction during just install in this workspace: cp cannot stat sase-core/target/release/sase-xprompt-lsp, chmod/mv fail, recipe still prints installed and exits 0. Follow-on isolated wait-prose ACE/LSP parity test then failed (sase-vl).

Independent reproduction while landing sase-x7.3.1 at a45669b26: monitor 9188wk0wvw5g (2026-09-06 18:50:34Z–19:50:37Z) built LSP 0.32.26 then 0.32.27, each time cp/chmod/mv failed against checkout-local target and the recipe printed installed. Live workspace LSP remained 0.32.9. cargo metadata --no-deps resolved target_directory=/mnt/poseidon/cargo-target; its release binary reported 0.32.27. Atomically copied that verified binary into only this workspace venv as a verification prerequisite repair. Binding validation against local core 010ddd6 (0.32.27) passes. No source patch or new duplicate task. Not caused by the canonical producer epic.
